title: Response Sensitivity and Reaction Speed
summary: Feedback in this topic discusses how different vehicle functions react to driver inputs or surrounding conditions, with examples spanning steering, touch controls, driver assistance, parking behavior, and auto-dimming.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe slow or problematic reactions, including delayed self-driving responses to lane changes and issues when problems arise.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention both precise or quick reactions and overly sensitive or slow behavior across unrelated features, without enough context to classify overall sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in the overall sentiment interpretation.
The cluster mixes multiple unrelated systems such as steering, touch inputs, parking behavior, auto-dimming, and self-driving, so it does not represent a single coherent feature area.
Examples are brief fragments with limited context, so some statements that sound favorable or unfavorable cannot be classified beyond their assigned sentiment.
